info.description: List the layer summaries for a volume.
info.title: Books API

requests.description: Add a user-upload volume and triggers processing.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/cloudloading/addBook

requests.description: Remove the book and its contents
requests.name: POST /books/v1/cloudloading/deleteBook

requests.description: Updates a user-upload volume.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/cloudloading/updateBook

requests.description: Returns a list of offline dictionary metadata available
requests.name: GET /books/v1/dictionary/listOfflineMetadata

requests.description: Gets information regarding the family that the user is part of.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/familysharing/getFamilyInfo

requests.description: Initiates sharing of the content with the user's family. Empty response indicates success.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/familysharing/share

requests.description: Initiates revoking content that has already been shared with the user's family. Empty response indicates success.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/familysharing/unshare

requests.description: Gets the current settings for the user.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/myconfig/getUserSettings

requests.description: Release downloaded content access restriction.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/myconfig/releaseDownloadAccess

requests.description: Request concurrent and download access restrictions.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/myconfig/requestAccess

requests.description: Request downloaded content access for specified volumes on the My eBooks shelf.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/myconfig/syncVolumeLicenses

requests.description: Sets the settings for the user. If a sub-object is specified, it will overwrite the existing sub-object stored in the server. Unspecified sub-objects will retain the existing value.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/myconfig/updateUserSettings

requests.description: Retrieves a list of annotations, possibly filtered.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/mylibrary/annotations

requests.description: Inserts a new annotation.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/mylibrary/annotations

requests.description: Gets the summary of specified layers.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/mylibrary/annotations/summary

requests.description: Deletes an annotation.
requests.name: DELETE /books/v1/mylibrary/annotations/{annotationId}
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates an existing annotation.
requests.name: PUT /books/v1/mylibrary/annotations/{annotationId}
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves a list of bookshelves belonging to the authenticated user.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/mylibrary/bookshelves

requests.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific bookshelf belonging to the authenticated user.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/mylibrary/bookshelves/{shelf}
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Adds a volume to a bookshelf.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/mylibrary/bookshelves/{shelf}/addVolume
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Clears all volumes from a bookshelf.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/mylibrary/bookshelves/{shelf}/clearVolumes
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Moves a volume within a bookshelf.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/mylibrary/bookshelves/{shelf}/moveVolume
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Removes a volume from a bookshelf.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/mylibrary/bookshelves/{shelf}/removeVolume
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets volume information for volumes on a bookshelf.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/mylibrary/bookshelves/{shelf}/volumes
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves my reading position information for a volume.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/mylibrary/readingpositions/{volumeId}
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Sets my reading position information for a volume.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/mylibrary/readingpositions/{volumeId}/setPosition
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns notification details for a given notification id.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/notification/get

requests.description: List categories for onboarding experience.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/onboarding/listCategories

requests.description: List available volumes under categories for onboarding experience.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/onboarding/listCategoryVolumes

requests.description: Returns a stream of personalized book clusters
requests.name: GET /books/v1/personalizedstream/get

requests.description: Accepts the promo offer.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/promooffer/accept

requests.description: Marks the promo offer as dismissed.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/promooffer/dismiss

requests.description: Returns a list of promo offers available to the user
requests.name: GET /books/v1/promooffer/get

requests.description: Returns Series metadata for the given series ids.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/series/get

requests.description: Returns Series membership data given the series id.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/series/membership/get

requests.description: Retrieves a list of public bookshelves for the specified user.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/users/{userId}/bookshelves
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific bookshelf for the specified user.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/users/{userId}/bookshelves/{shelf}
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Retrieves volumes in a specific bookshelf for the specified user.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/users/{userId}/bookshelves/{shelf}/volumes
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Performs a book search.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/volumes

requests.description: Return a list of books in My Library.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/volumes/mybooks

requests.description: Return a list of recommended books for the current user.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/volumes/recommended

requests.description: Rate a recommended book for the current user.
requests.name: POST /books/v1/volumes/recommended/rate

requests.description: Return a list of books uploaded by the current user.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/volumes/useruploaded
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads

requests.description: Gets volume information for a single volume.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/volumes/{volumeId}
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Return a list of associated books.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/volumes/{volumeId}/associated
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the volume annotations for a volume and layer.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/volumes/{volumeId}/layers/{layerId}
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the volume annotation.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/volumes/{volumeId}/layers/{layerId}/annotations/{annotationId}
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the annotation data for a volume and layer.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/volumes/{volumeId}/layers/{layerId}/data
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the annotation data.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/volumes/{volumeId}/layers/{layerId}/data/{annotationDataId}
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: List the layer summaries for a volume.
requests.name: GET /books/v1/volumes/{volumeId}/layersummary
requests.note: Replace {{BOOKS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
